title: Boss Challenge: Cool House
summary: Design homes that stay comfortable in a Chennai summer and a Delhi winter, without air conditioners or heaters.

ib.note: Unit summative-style design task (Criteria A and D)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Heat Transfer in Nature

objectives: I can apply conduction, convection and radiation to design a comfortable building.
I can justify design choices and weigh cost against benefit.
misconceptions: The only way to cool a house is an air conditioner.
